_note: Per-array-type UV-laser etch parameters for the PFLM wafer. Source of truth; consumed by winlase job building. P = number of PASSES (mark-loop count), S = mark speed mm/s. Laser POWER is NOT per-array here -- it stays fixed by the WinLase default profile (Singulation's read-only power/freq safety gate is preserved); only passes + crosshatch angles vary per array. Crosshatch = two fill passes at the listed angles; hatch/pass width 0.01 mm.
